risk_if_not_implemented: Without Control Assurance Automation (CAA) Data Feed Identification, automated control assurance results may be manipulated, misattributed or lose integrity, causing misplaced confidence in control effectiveness. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2).

compensating_control_1.name: Inventory of Technology Asset Event Logging
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to maintain a current and accurate inventory of technology-related Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) being logged.
compensating_control_1.justification: Inventory of Technology Asset Event Logging (MON-15) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) Data Feed Identification (MON-37) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a Security Incident Event Manager (SIEM), or similar automated tool, to support the centralized collection of event logs and security-relevant telemetry.
compensating_control_2.justification: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry (MON-05) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) Data Feed Identification (MON-37) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
